name: dotnet-stage-best-effort-copy
body: stage_dotnet_frontend (the shared staging path stage_csharp and stage_sql both call) treats the dotnet publish as the success test (exit status ok and the published exe exists) and copies the exe into the frontends stage dir best-effort (`let _ = std::fs::copy`), so a failed copy still returns the language name (`csharp`/`sql`) into APG_LANGUAGES while its env var (APG_FRONTEND_CSHARP/APG_FRONTEND_SQL) points at the published path under OUT_DIR/<dist_dir>. Upgrade to a fail-closed copy (return nothing when the copy fails) if staged-dir presence must ever be verified at build time.
